description: This file implements GDB stub functionality for Xtensa architecture within Zephyr OS, including register access, exception handling, breakpoints, and GDB communication.

methods.name: read_sreg
methods.description: Reads a special register based on its descriptor and updates the register structure.

methods.name: get_gdb_exception_reason
methods.description: Translates exception cause codes into GDB exception reasons.

methods.name: copy_to_ctx
methods.description: Copies register states from stack into GDB context for debugging.

methods.name: restore_from_ctx
methods.description: Restores register states from GDB context back into stack after debugging.

methods.name: arch_gdb_continue
methods.description: Resumes execution after a breakpoint or step command.

methods.name: arch_gdb_step
methods.description: Sets up the processor to execute a single instruction step.

methods.name: arch_gdb_init
methods.description: Initializes GDB stub, sets register indices, enables interrupts, and triggers initial breakpoint.

methods.name: z_gdb_isr
methods.description: Interrupt Service Routine for handling GDB debug exceptions and invoking the main GDB loop.
